WITH first_seller AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.seller_id) AS seller_id
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  LEFT(o.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
  LEFT(fs.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  c.customer_zip_code_prefix AS customer_zip_code_prefix,
  s.seller_zip_code_prefix AS seller_zip_code_prefix,
  CAST(customer_geo.geolocation_lat AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS customer_latitude,
  CAST(customer_geo.geolocation_lng AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS customer_longitude,
  CAST(seller_geo.geolocation_lat AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS seller_latitude,
  CAST(seller_geo.geolocation_lng AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS seller_longitude,
  6371 * 2 * ASIN(
    SQRT(
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS((seller_geo.geolocation_lat - customer_geo.geolocation_lat) / 2)), 2) +
      COS(RADIANS(customer_geo.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(seller_geo.geolocation_lat)) *
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS((seller_geo.geolocation_lng - customer_geo.geolocation_lng) / 2)), 2)
    )
  ) AS distance_km,
  o.order_purchase_timestamp AS order_purchase_timestamp,
  o.order_delivered_customer_date AS order_delivered_timestamp,
  ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_purchase_timestamp::date))::INT AS delivery_time_days
FROM orders o
JOIN first_seller fs ON o.order_id = fs.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN sellers s ON fs.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN geolocation customer_geo ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = customer_geo.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
JOIN geolocation seller_geo ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = seller_geo.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_geo.geolocation_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_geo.geolocation_lng IS NOT NULL
  AND seller_geo.geolocation_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND seller_geo.geolocation_lng IS NOT NULL;
